newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fortune Cement Q1 net sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Fortune Cement Q1 net sharply up.

text.p: Fortune Cement Corp said on Tuesday its net income in the first quarter rose to 133.4 million pesos compared with 105.9 million pesos in the same period last year.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the firm said sales volume for the first quarter rose 24 percent thanks to the upgrading of its production line.
It said it expected net income to more than double to 1.25 billion pesos this year from 517 million last year.
Additional clinker capacity of 1.05 million tonnes would be operational by July 1997, the firm said.
Also, production costs were projected to be lower with the use of its own power plant, it said.
